name: Ashbee Dora Vineyards
description: In Grapevine Landing Road, NC, Ashbee Dora Vineyards grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on an independent apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
